Indexes.Name: ux_alerts_deduplication_key
Indexes.Signature: U|cols=namespace_id,deduplication_key|inc=|desc=|filter=deduplication_key IS NOT NULL AND resolved_at_utc IS NULL|seq=False

Checks.Name: ck_alerts_job_ref_pair
Checks.Sql: (job_id IS NULL AND job_ref IS NULL) OR (job_id IS NOT NULL AND job_ref IS NOT NULL)

Checks.Name: ck_checkpoints_kind_shape
Checks.Sql: (kind_code NOT IN (10, 40) OR (status_code IS NULL AND due_at_utc IS NULL)) AND (kind_code NOT IN (20, 30, 50) OR status_code IS NOT NULL) AND (kind_code <> 30 OR due_at_utc IS NOT NULL)

Checks.Name: ck_checkpoints_value_pair
Checks.Sql: (value_format_id = 0 AND value IS NULL) OR (value_format_id <> 0 AND value IS NOT NULL)

Checks.Name: ck_events_detail_pair
Checks.Sql: (detail_format_id = 0 AND detail IS NULL) OR (detail_format_id <> 0 AND detail IS NOT NULL)

Indexes.Name: ux_jobs_deduplication_key_child
Indexes.Signature: U|cols=parent_id,deduplication_key|inc=|desc=|filter=deduplication_key IS NOT NULL AND parent_id IS NOT NULL|seq=False

Indexes.Name: ux_jobs_deduplication_key_root
Indexes.Signature: U|cols=namespace_id,deduplication_key|inc=|desc=|filter=deduplication_key IS NOT NULL AND parent_id IS NULL|seq=False

Checks.Name: ck_jobs_input_pair
Checks.Sql: (input_format_id = 0 AND input IS NULL) OR (input_format_id <> 0 AND input IS NOT NULL)

Indexes.Name: ix_runtimes_claim_ready
Indexes.Signature: I|cols=namespace_id,priority_code,next_run_at_utc,job_id,status_code|inc=|desc=priority_code|filter=status_code IN (10, 20) AND next_run_at_utc IS NOT NULL|seq=False

Indexes.Name: ix_runtimes_lane
Indexes.Signature: I|cols=lane_id,job_id|inc=|desc=|filter=lane_id IS NOT NULL AND status_code IN (10, 15, 20, 30, 50)|seq=False

Checks.Name: ck_runtimes_blocked_lane
Checks.Sql: status_code <> 15 OR lane_id IS NOT NULL

Checks.Name: ck_runtimes_inflight_leased
Checks.Sql: status_code <> 50 OR leased_by_worker_id IS NOT NULL

Checks.Name: ck_runtimes_lease_consistency
Checks.Sql: (leased_by_worker_id IS NULL AND lease_expires_at_utc IS NULL) OR (leased_by_worker_id IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at_utc IS NOT NULL)

Checks.Name: ck_runtimes_ready_due
Checks.Sql: status_code <> 10 OR next_run_at_utc IS NOT NULL

Checks.Name: ck_runtimes_result_pair
Checks.Sql: (result_format_id = 0 AND result IS NULL) OR (result_format_id <> 0 AND result IS NOT NULL)

Checks.Name: ck_steps_reason_pair
Checks.Sql: reason_message IS NULL OR reason_code IS NOT NULL

Checks.Name: ck_steps_result_pair
Checks.Sql: (result_format_id = 0 AND result IS NULL) OR (result_format_id <> 0 AND result IS NOT NULL)

Checks.Name: ck_steps_terminal_no_retry
Checks.Sql: status_code NOT IN (100, 200, 230) OR next_retry_at_utc IS NULL

Checks.Name: ck_tags_value_search
Checks.Sql: (value IS NULL AND value_search IS NULL) OR (value IS NOT NULL AND value_search IS NOT NULL)
